title: Protect Your Heart From the
style: Warm, wise vocal jazz ballad at 115 BPM with gentle swing. Female vocalist Jazz with sincere, caring, and slightly smoky delivery. Emotional but empowering lyrics about protecting your heart after getting hurt. Gentle melodic scat in the break. Warm piano, upright bass, soft brushed drums, subtle strings or horns. Reflective, mature, and beautiful jazz production — like a classic torch song with modern warmth and wisdom.
lyrics:
[Intro – Jazz, soft and sincere]
Mmm… yeah…
Now you know…
[Verse 1 – Jazz]
You gave it all, you opened up wide
Let somebody in, and they hurt you inside
Smiled at the promises, believed every word
Now you’re sitting here, feeling broken and hurt
[Pre-Chorus]
You learned the lesson, it wasn’t for free
Now you know exactly what you need
[Chorus – Jazz]
Protect your heart from the start
Guard it gently, don’t fall too hard
Love is beautiful, but it can break you apart
So protect your heart… from the start
[Verse 2 – Jazz]
They say it’s worth it when it’s real and true
But you gotta know who’s really loving you
Don’t rush in blind, don’t ignore the signs
Take your time, baby, protect what’s mine
[Chorus]
Protect your heart from the start
Don’t let just anybody play that part
You deserve a love that won’t tear you apart
So protect your heart… from the start
[Bridge – Jazz, warm and knowing]
Now you know…
Now you know what it feels like to fall too fast
Now you know…
You can still love, but you don’t have to crash
A little jazz in your soul will help you last
[Scat Break – Jazz, gentle and melodic]
Doo-bee-doo… protect…
Scat-scat… your heart…
Bee-boo-bop… from the start…
Wah-wah… now you know…
[Final Chorus – Jazz, stronger and wiser]
Protect your heart from the start
Keep it safe while you’re playing your part
Love is magic, but it needs a little art
So protect your heart… from the start
[Outro – Jazz, soft and caring]
Now you know…
Protect your heart…
From the start…
